page.notes: The Greek passage is printed skewed at the foot of the text block. Several Greek words are doubtful: the opening words "Οἱ ἐξ ἡμῶν" and "Θεὸν μέγιστον ἀρχιερέως" and the word "ἡνωμένον" are my best reading, not certain. The Greek ends with "ἔχον-" at the line end, which continues on the next page. The opening Q of "Quæ" is a large initial and is joined to its word. Spelling of u/v and i/j has been modernised as instructed; all other spelling is as printed, including "ampullatis" and "sesquipedalibus".
